data_description.channels: Leave empty unless auto-discovery missed a channel, e.g. electro_ac_p_lsum_t1,electro_ac_p_lsum_t2
data_description.prices: One price per channel: t1=6.97,t2=3.86. For a tariff change add a dated entry: t1@2026-10-01=7.86 - hours before that date keep the old price. Shortcuts t1..t4, tsum, total expand to channel names; dates are local (2026-10-01 or 01.10.2026). Use ';' between pairs if you write prices with a decimal comma. Editing prices rebuilds the cost statistics over the full stored history.

error.invalid_prices: Could not parse these price entries: {entries}. Expected key=price or key@date=price, e.g. t1=6.97 or t1@2026-10-01=7.86
